text:
olivia_sales: Acadia Health wants a 2-week Private deploy POC. Key asks: preserve client src IP to their on‑prem proxy, support mTLS from our connector to their egress proxy, BYOIP for stable allowlist, and delta pricing vs Dedicated. can we confirm constraints?

mike_netops: quick q: PrivateLink only or open to TGW/peering? preserving src ip over Privatelink is hard; options: 1) passthrough L4 on customer edge, 2) our egress NAT + BYOIP sticky EIP. both have tradeoffs.

jess_solutions: theyll request KMS/HSM, SOC2 attestation, and data residency for logs. i can attach compliance 1-pager.

olivia_sales: they prefer PrivateLink but said "open" if other option preserves IP. port 443 only; need stable egress IPs for the POC.

mike_netops: firewall snippet for their netops: `allow tcp from 203.0.113.55/32 to 10.0.2.0/24 port 443` and `allow tcp from 198.51.100.0/28 to 10.0.2.0/24 port 443`. open 8443 outbound to our control plane if using Private deploy. keepalive: 30s.

ryan_engineering: pricing note: Dedicated = usage pricing; Private deploy = license + infra and compliance add-ons. for a 2-week POC recommend eval credit + capped infra estimate; i'll draft ranges after model/QPS.

infra_bot: POC created: POC-ACADIA-4943210000 owners: olivia_sales, jess_solutions, mike_netops start: 2026-05-12 duration: 14d.

olivia_sales: thanks — mike/jess/ryan please post final snippet, diagram, and 1-pager in this thread by EOD so i can reply to customer.

mike_netops: will post config + notes in ~90m.

jess_solutions: compiling compliance links now.
